content:
Loaded the run C1/awf_namanga_2023_1042061 (model allenai/OlmoEarth-v1-FT-AWF-Base, 128x128 window grid = 16,384 windows, all valid) and ran the package's review-set ranking at a 5% budget. That yields **819 windows to check**, ordered lowest first by the mean per-window top-1-minus-top-2 logit margin (margin 0.108 to 0.994 for the full set, versus a median of 4.468 across all windows — so these are the windows where the model was least decisive between its two leading classes).

**Why these windows:** the signal is the model's own uncertainty — when the top two class logits are nearly tied, the argmax label is most likely wrong there. Many of the top windows also sit on map class boundaries (boundary_neighbours counts differing predicted neighbours), which compounds the suspicion.
